existing_group_assignments.rationale: Decrease, Triglyceride shares the triglyceride object with the existing increased-triglyceride events but differs in direction/process, warranting curator review.
Reduced granulosa cell proliferation placeholder not valid; omitted.

new_groups.rationale: Sperm count, impaired spermatogenesis and decreased spermatogenesis concern the male germ cell production axis with distinct endpoints; 1758 and 1798 are near-synonyms but sperm count is a distinct measure.
Impaired spermatogenesis and decreased spermatogenesis describe the same reduced spermatogenesis event.
Both describe decreased cortisol, one also including 11β-(OH) testosterone.
Inhibition of different chitin-degrading enzymes (chitinase vs chitobiase) share the chitin degradation context but are distinct enzymes.
Urothelial cell injury/death and urothelial tumor share the urothelial tissue object but are distinct processes.
Both concern reduced estrogen-related ovarian/gonadal function but in different contexts; flagged for review.
Increased differentiation to testis and male-biased sex ratio are related sex determination endpoints at different levels.
Abnormal osmoregulation and body fluid overload are related but distinct processes.
